How to Deploy a Vue App: It Depends on How You Built It

Vue ships in three shapes. A client-side SPA (Vite) builds to static files in `dist/`: host them on object storage plus a CDN, and add a SPA fallback so route refreshes don't 404. A Nuxt SSR app is a live Node server (`node .output/server/index.mjs`): deploy it like any Node app on a port.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/deploy-vue-app/
